summary: Rituals is multinational cosmetics store retail chain, founded in 2000. Type: private company. About 8,930 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: The Amsterdam-born home and body care brand with over 1,100 shops, now a €2.4 billion company, hiring office roles in Amsterdam.

culture.text: Staff often studied at UvA, VU, Amsterdam UAS or Erasmus, mostly in economics, business, marketing and communication.
It describes its people as open-minded, customer-first and energetic, and is a certified B Corp.
It has 10,000+ employees and 1,100+ shops in 43+ countries.

open.text: Rituals Cosmetics Enterprise B.V. and Rituals Cosmetics E-commerce B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Both current Amsterdam openings are open to non-Dutch speakers.

growth.text: Founder Raymond Cloosterman grew Rituals to €2.4 billion in revenue in 25 years.
It recently launched a baby care line.

worth_knowing.text: Current openings are senior and manager level, not starter roles.
A Leiden law graduate rose to become Rituals' director in China.
